test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man crosses a 375 m road in 75 sec. His speed (in km/h) is:
solution:
**Given:**

Distance (d) = 375 m

Time (t) = 75 sec

**Formula used:**

Speed (v) = dfrac{distance}{time}

**Calculation:**

v = dfrac{375}{75} m/s

⇒ v = 5 m/s

To convert m/s to km/h:

1 m/s = 3.6 km/h

⇒ v = 5 × 3.6 km/h

⇒ v = 18 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
